description: lastPageIndex returns -1 for an empty collection, so summarize's loop is skipped; but for total exactly divisible it is correct — the trap is that paginate itself is fine.

bugs.hint: lastPageIndex(0, n) returns -1; callers that treat it as a count or index into an array underflow.

traps.why: slice() clamps out-of-range indices, so start/end past the end is correct, not a bug.
hasMore using `end < all.length` is correct for the final page.
